name: ML4W Dotfiles
summary: Full Hyprland desktop with a settings app, wallpaper-driven colors and guided installer.
description: ML4W OS turns Hyprland into a full desktop with its own settings app and colors generated from your wallpaper for every component. It supports Arch-based distributions such as CachyOS, Fedora, Ubuntu and openSUSE Tumbleweed, and a Live ISO lets you try it in a virtual machine before installing. The setup script installs a large selection of apps alongside the configs.
